description: Commodity Alert Webhook — register a URL to receive push alerts when a commodity signal crosses a threshold. Supports alerts on signal changes (BULLISH → BEARISH), confidence drops below a floor, or climate stress score crossing a level. Returns a subscriptionId for management. Alerts fire within 30 minutes of a signal change. Useful for autonomous agents that need to react to commodity market shifts without polling. x402 paid (first month), USDC on Base.

alertOn.description: Trigger type. signal_change = any BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL flip. confidence_drop = confidence falls below threshold. climate_stress = climateScore crosses level. Default: signal_change.

symbols.description: Commodity symbols to monitor. E.g. ["WHEAT", "WTI"]. Use ["*"] for all 11.

threshold.description: For confidence_drop: minimum confidence floor (0–1). For climate_stress: score level (0–100). Not used for signal_change.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL to receive POST alerts.

name: forecast.subscribe

subscriptionId.description: Subscription ID for updates and cancellation.
